title: Limitation memo - Jane Example v Example Widgets Ltd
response: The claim is time-barred [[cite:c1]], and notice was given [[cite:c2]].

sources.label: Example Limitation Act (fictional)
sources.text: An action founded on simple contract shall not be brought after the expiration of six years from the date on which the cause of action accrued.

sources.label: Letter from example.org (fictional)
sources.text: Dear Ms Example, we write to give notice of the claim. Yours faithfully, Example Widgets Ltd, example.org

citations.claim: Contract claims are barred after six years.
citations.quote: shall not be brought after the expiration of six years

citations.claim: Notice of the claim was given.
